LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 2.3.1 WORD CLASSES VERB: MAIN AND AUXILIARY VERBS,TENSE AND ASPECT

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.3: Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes verb: Main and Auxiliary Verbs,Tense and Aspect
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 5

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes verb: Main and Auxiliary Verbs,Tense and Aspect, part of Strand 2 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 10 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why are tense, time and aspect important in communication? 2. How do we derive verbs from other verbs, nouns and adjectives for communication?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes verb: Main and Auxiliary Verbs,Tense and Aspect together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Learning to learn - Self-discipline: The learners seek advice and support from each other as they search for regular and

irregular verbs from signed, printed or digital texts.

● Critical Thinking - Active listening: The learner actively observes or listens to a signed or an audio text and identifies

gradable and non-gradable adverbs and adverbs of place and time.

Values:
● Love: The learner’s generosity is enhanced as they share ideas with others on adverbs.

● Responsibility: The learner engages in the assigned role as they search for regular and irregular verbs from print or

digital texts.

Suggested Learning Resources:

Digital devices, internet, Adapted course books book, online materials, sign language dictionary, English dictionary, audio

visual recordings, Substitution Tables, Charts, Crossword Puzzle Templates
